findings.oracle: Real CutterBridge(): asserts name==ToolName.CUTTER, r2 is None, the static/decompile/patching capability surface is True, and every one of the 95 declared tool functions resolves to a callable bound method (resolved list == declared names) - breaks if a function ships without a backing method or the identity/capability wiring regresses.

Real tool_definition: asserts len(functions)==95 AND len(set(names))==95 AND count of names resolving to callable bound methods==95, tying the bare count to uniqueness and real method backing - a phantom/duplicate name or dropped method now breaks the gate.

No mock: PATH is genuinely scrubbed of every dir holding a rizin/radare2 binary and tool_path points at a real empty dir, so the real is_available() finds no backend; asserts initialize raises ToolError matching 'cutter not available'.
No mock: calls real initialize(tool_path=<real dir>); asserts os.environ['PATH'].split(pathsep)[0] == str(tool_dir), gating the genuine env-prepend branch.
No mock: seeds PATH with a sentinel dir then real-initializes; asserts tool_dir is entries[0] AND the prior sentinel survives in entries[1:], proving prepend (not overwrite) semantics.
No mock: pre-seeds PATH with tool_dir then real-initializes; asserts entries.count(tool_dir_str) == 1, gating the real 'if tool_dir not in current_path' dedup branch.

Real rizin loads real System32 kernel32.dll via str path; asserts BinaryInfo field-by-field against independent PE facts: name, size (asyncio.to_thread stat, computed in test), file_type=='pe32+', is_64bit is True, architecture=='x86', path is Path, and '.text'/'.rdata' sections present. Replaces 64-byte zero fake + shutil.which patch.

Real rizin loads kernel32.dll via str and via Path on two bridges; asserts name/size/file_type/is_64bit/architecture/path are equal across both input forms, proving Path coercion is indistinguishable from the string path. Replaces fake binary + patch.

Real rizin /x search over a test-planted blob (3 copies of DEADBEEF at fixed offsets, 1 of CAFE1234); asserts marker hit count == independent _count_occurrences(blob, marker)==3 and unique hit count == _count_occurrences==1. Drives real search end to end instead of recording the command string.

Real rizin search with raw bytes input over the same planted blob; asserts hit count == independent _count_occurrences==3, bytes-input count == equivalent str-input count, and an absent 6-byte pattern returns []. Gates the bytes.hex() encoding path against real results.
